title: Air Traffic Planner

startNotice.title: For learning only
startNotice.text: This role is **planning arithmetic only**. All airports, flights and figures are made up, and the separation tables and rules are set for the exercise. It is **not real air traffic control**, which needs a licence, approved procedures, surveillance and proper training.

description: Runway arrival spacing, departure slot delays, in-trail separation on a route, and holding and diversion fuel: planning arithmetic worked from the figures, with every rule stated.
